subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept a current-run private transcript assistant turn with stop/end_turn as sufficient proof to settle a lost-context subagent run as successful?
rationale: This is the maintainer-stated safer boundary, but it intentionally changes lifecycle and parent delivery semantics for stale active runs.

options.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head validation, keeping session-store terminal state authoritative and using private transcript recovery only for explicit successful terminal turns.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for live Agent Teams or Gateway proof that loses context mid-run before accepting the lifecycle recovery behavior.

options.title: Keep Error-Only Fallback
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide lost-context recovery must not infer success from transcript state.

recommendation.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head validation, keeping session-store terminal state authoritative and using private transcript recovery only for explicit successful terminal turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer comment defined the private transcript/status boundary this PR implements.
